name: 包装&物流工具箱
description: 免费在线的包装设计与物流测算工具集：纸盒刀模设计、集装箱装柜计算、条码标签设计、Markdown 编辑。四款工具全部在浏览器内运行，无需注册、无需上传数据。
description_en: A free browser-based toolbox for packaging design and logistics planning: carton dieline (die-cut) design, container load planning, barcode label design, and Markdown editing. Every tool runs entirely in the browser — no sign-up, no data upload.

tools.name: 刀模设计 DieCut Designer
tools.description: 参数化生成上千种标准纸盒刀模（carton dieline），实时预览，可导出 SVG / DXF / PDF，对接印刷打样。Parametric generation of 1200+ standard carton dielines with live preview and SVG/DXF/PDF export.

tools.name: 装柜大师 Loader Master
tools.description: 集装箱 3D 装柜仿真与装箱计算，输出 3D 码放方案、装载率与总重统计。3D container load simulation and bin-packing with utilization and total-weight metrics.

tools.name: 标签编辑器 Label Editor
tools.description: 浏览器内的矢量条码标签设计工具，支持 Code 128 / QR 等条码二维码、多对象编排、模板复用、PDF / PNG 导出与 Excel 批量套打。A vector barcode and QR label designer with batch printing and PDF/PNG export.

tools.name: Markdown 编辑器 Lite MD Editor
tools.description: 类 Word 的本地 Markdown 可视化编辑器，完全离线运行，支持 PDF 导出。A local, offline Markdown editor with Word-like visual editing and PDF export.
